sources.note: Safety data sheet section 3 for a family of powders; the ranges span the family, not one powder. The sheet prints several ranges per ingredient "due to varying composition" and does not say which belongs to which powder; stored as the union of the printed ranges.

Section 9 gives the appearance "Small black/gray flakes"; the Alliant SDS listing (https://www.alliantpowder.com/resources/sds.aspx) links this sheet for Power Pistol. The Power Pro Series sheet prints the same appearance, while the Power Pro product pages state spherical grains, so the line may not be specific to this powder.

Composition: Alliant Powder SDS "30-40 Smokeless Powder", revision 03/01/2017, version 2.1; the listed ingredients are taken as the whole composition. Nitrogen in the nitrocellulose 12.6 to 13.4 % (Mass fraction of N for powder records, where safety data sheets print none: from pyrocellulose (12.6 %) to guncotton (13.4 %), the US grades in AMCP 706-175, Solid Propellants, Part One, 1964, p. 46). Value at the mean of the 16 vertices of the composition ranges (fractions summing to 100 %) and the mean nitrogen; min and max over that value and the vertices at both nitrogen bounds, extremes between vertices not searched. sha256 over the solver code and the ingredient data used.

25 training rows of this table (hold-out by cartridge, docs/data/published-loads.md); M3 parameters vivacity, energy fitted by the load-table fit (docs/research/interior-load-table-fit-parameters.md), candidate B; thermochemistry prior; the other values of interior are fixed inputs of the fit; start pressure per row from defaultStartPressure in core: 30.0 MPa at a barrel of 300 mm and longer; below by the bullet construction of the printed bullet type: lead 24.3 MPa, plated 30.9 MPa, jacketed 30.8 MPa, monolithic 50.0 MPa. Effective model parameters, not load data.
